## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] CI checks passed
- [ ] Tests or manual validation completed
- [ ] Documentation updated where applicable

## Risk / governance

- [ ] Security, authentication, permissions, infrastructure, and breaking API impacts reviewed
- [ ] Any required explicit reviewers have approved
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed

SUN policy: https://github.com/sunstriker2009/sun-ecosystem/blob/main/docs/governance/GIT-WORKFLOW.md
